nutrition.page.title: Nutrition profile
nutrition.page.body: Configure targets and weights used by the solver as soft constraints. This is not clinical guidance.
nutrition.nutrients.body: Each row can be explicitly disabled or define minimum, target and maximum.
nutrition.modifiers.body: Apply kcal or percentage deltas to selected day archetypes.
allergy.page.title: Allergies & intolerances
allergy.page.body: Enabled rules are hard constraints: incompatible recipes are removed before ranking.
allergy.safetyNotice: Checks cover the structured catalog composition and do not replace reading labels on real products.
preference.page.title: Food preferences
preference.page.body: Preferences affect ranking; auto-exclude only removes a target from automatic suggestions.
meal.page.title: Meal classes
meal.page.body: Reusable definitions referenced by meal slots in day classes.
day.page.title: Day classes
day.page.body: Define context, work windows and ordered meal slots without hardcoding your schedule.
cycle.page.title: Personal cycle
cycle.page.body: Map every cycle day to a DayClass. The sequence must remain contiguous from 1 to N.
onboarding.title: Initial configuration
onboarding.body: The guided flow saves a local draft and activates the whole configuration atomically only at the end.
onboarding.resume.title: Initial configuration to complete
onboarding.resume.body: Resume the draft without changing the active configuration.
onboarding.completed.title: Configuration onboarding complete
onboarding.completed.body: You can reopen the flow to review setup; final activation remains atomic.
onboarding.catalogReady: The local catalog is available. Plan preview/generation will arrive with the planning engine.
onboarding.catalogPending: The catalog is not available yet; configuration can still be completed.
onboarding.nutritionAdvanced: Macro/fiber details remain editable in the Nutrition Profile editor.
onboarding.mealAdvanced: You are starting from the editable JSON template; rules and energy shares can be refined in Meal Classes.
onboarding.dayAdvanced: Schedule, capabilities and template slots can be refined in Day Classes.
onboarding.step1.title: Language, units and appearance
onboarding.step2.title: Nutrition profile
onboarding.step2.body: Set base energy, tolerance and initial preset.
onboarding.step3.title: Allergies & intolerances
onboarding.step3.body: Add safety constraints that the generator cannot bypass.
onboarding.step4.title: Global preferences
onboarding.step4.body: Choose what should appear more or less often and voluntary exclusions.
onboarding.step5.title: Meal classes
onboarding.step5.body: Rename or remap the initial template meal classes.
onboarding.step6.title: Day classes
onboarding.step6.body: Adapt the template days to your real archetypes.
onboarding.step7.title: Cycle 1–31
onboarding.step7.body: Build the repeating sequence of your days.
onboarding.step8.title: Review and activation
onboarding.step8.body: Check consistency and activate the setup in one atomic operation.
config.transfer.title: Configuration import/export
config.transfer.body: The structural preset excludes nutrition, allergies/intolerances, preferences, time zone and people multiplier; full backup remains separate.
